spans.claim: Snow Gregory was found dead with a Jack of Clubs playing card
spans.anchor: a playing card--the Jack of Clubs
spans.span: When they got him to the mortuary and searched his clothes they found nothing except a little tin box of white powder which proved to be cocaine, and a playing card--the Jack of Clubs!

spans.claim: Colonel Boundary received threatening cards signed Jack o' Judgment
spans.anchor: a soiled and stained playing card, the Knave of Clubs
spans.span: It was not a letter at all--as it proved--but a soiled and stained playing card, the Knave of Clubs.

spans.claim: Olaf Hanson was the chief witness and was poisoned in court
spans.anchor: the witness is dead

spans.claim: Maisie White impersonated Jack o' Judgment to gather evidence
spans.anchor: she put out her hand and laid it on his
spans.span: She did not know what impelled her to do the thing, but she put out her hand and laid it on his.

spans.claim: Jack o' Judgment used microphones and a gramophone voice
spans.anchor: Detectaphones!
spans.span: Detectaphones!" He took Pinto's knife from his hand and prised one of the discs loose.

spans.claim: Pinto Silva was arrested for forgery and blackmail
spans.anchor: Pinto Silva to-night--we only just heard of it

spans.claim: Colonel Boundary faked his death and escaped disguised as a carpenter
spans.anchor: A stoutish, grey-haired man descended from a third-class carriage
spans.span: CHAPTER XXXIX JACK O' JUDGMENT REVEALED A stoutish, grey-haired man descended from a third-class carriage at Chatham Station and inquired of a porter the way to the dockyard.

spans.claim: Jack o' Judgment is Sir Stanley Belcom, the First Commissioner
spans.anchor: Sir Stanley Belcom! Sir Stanley!
spans.span: Sir Stanley Belcom! Sir Stanley!" he softly whispered.

spans.claim: The colonel's flat was destroyed by fire set by Jack o' Judgment
spans.anchor: Albemarle Place was blocked with fire engines
spans.span: Half an hour later, Albemarle Place was blocked with fire engines and a dozen hoses were playing in vain upon the roaring furnace behind the gutted walls of Colonel Dan Boundary's residence.

spans.claim: The gang's money was destroyed by acid in the bank safe
spans.anchor: a box filled with a very strong acid
spans.span: The second package was a box filled with a very strong acid," said the colonel.

spans.claim: Lollie Marsh and Crewe escaped by aeroplane to South America
spans.anchor: an aeroplane passed over Finisterre yesterday afternoon
spans.span: To satisfy myself in regard to Crewe, I telegraphed to an Englishman at Finisterre, who is a good friend of mine and who lives in a wild and isolated spot somewhere near the lighthouse, and he sent me back a message to the effect that an aeroplane passed over Finisterre yesterday afternoon soon after lunch time.

spans.claim: Maisie White returned from captivity and refused to reveal details
spans.anchor: She was, of course, detained and held prisoner somewhere
spans.span: She was, of course, detained and held prisoner somewhere, and last night--she will not give me any details--she was carried from the house where she had been kept prisoner.

spans.claim: The colonel's voice was transmitted from a hidden office beneath
spans.anchor: a private office which was simply furnished and had in one corner what appeared to be a telephone box
spans.span: Inside this was a private office which was simply furnished and had in one corner what appeared to be a telephone box.

spans.claim: Pinto Silva was caught with counterfeit money and forgery tools
spans.anchor: a thick pad of counterfeit money on one corner of the table
spans.span: There was a thick pad of counterfeit money on one corner of the table, held down by a paper weight; little bottles of acids were scattered about, and near the table was a small lever press, so small that a man might carry it in a corner of his handbag.

spans.claim: Colonel Boundary killed his former butler who betrayed him
spans.anchor: He had the sense to see that nothing could be done for the dying man
spans.span: He had the sense to see that nothing could be done for the dying man, however, and that a change of position would probably hasten the end.

spans.claim: Sir Stanley Belcom confessed to being Jack o' Judgment before dying
spans.anchor: Poor old Jack o' Judgment! This is going to be a first-class scandal

spans.claim: The gang was dismantled and the culprits arrested or fled
spans.anchor: The Boundary Gang is dismantled, Colonel Dan Boundary is killed

spans.claim: Maisie White and Stafford King are romantically involved
spans.anchor: He took her unresisting hand in his
spans.span: He took her unresisting hand in his, and under the cover of the tablecloth held it tight.

spans.claim: The false assumption that Maisie White is Jack o' Judgment is refuted
spans.anchor: I do not believe for one moment that you are Jack o' Judgment
spans.span: Now, I'm telling you before we go any further that I do not believe for one moment that you are Jack o' Judgment.

spans.claim: Jack o' Judgment used a gramophone voice to confuse the gang
spans.anchor: it was a gramophone voice
spans.span: Of course, it was a gramophone voice.
